aboutInfo: This adapter is free and open source. If you find it useful, please consider supporting its development with a small donation.
descAdd: Write a link, magnet link or NZB link to add it to this program.
descAltSpeed: Switches the program's alternative speed limits on or off.
descConnection: At least one download program answered the last query.
descDownloading: True while a download of this program is loading or being post-processed.
descError: Unknown before the first answer, empty while all is well, otherwise the program's own message.
descEta: Seconds until the download is complete; empty when the program cannot tell.
descForceStart: Starts the download right away, ignoring the queue.
descFreeSpace: Free space in the program's download folder.
descItemError: Error message of the program; empty while all is well.
descItemPaused: True pauses this download, false resumes it.
descLastFailed: Name of the download that failed last.
descLastFinished: Name of the download that finished last; written on every finish, also when the name repeats.
descOnline: The program answered the last query.
descPaused: True pauses the program, false resumes it.
descProgramsAllOnline: True when every configured download program answered the last query.
descProgramsOnline: Number of download programs that answered the last query.
descProgramsTotal: Number of configured and enabled download programs.
descRatio: Uploaded amount divided by downloaded amount.
descRemove: Removes the download from the program's list; the files stay on disk.
descSpeedLimit: Maximum download speed of the program; 0 means unlimited.
descSummaryActive: Downloads loading or being post-processed, over all programs.
descSummaryDownloadSpeed: Download speed of all reachable programs together.
descSummaryDownloading: True while any download of any program is loading or being post-processed.
descSummaryPauseAll: True pauses every reachable program, false resumes them.
descSummaryQueued: Downloads waiting in a queue, over all programs.
descSummaryUploadSpeed: Upload speed of all reachable torrent programs together.
descUploadLimit: Maximum upload speed of the program; 0 means unlimited.
dmChanged: This program was changed or removed while the dialog was open — open its card again.
dmDeleteConfirm: Delete “%s”? The device and its datapoints are removed. Nothing changes in the program itself, no file is deleted.
dmEnabled: Active — the adapter asks this program
dmHostTaken: This program is already set up at this address — enter a different address or port
dmNameHelp: The display name of the card and of the device.
dmNeedLogin: The program asks for a login
dmNoDevices: The account has no JDownloader that is not set up yet. Start JDownloader and connect it to My.JDownloader, then add it again.
dmPathHelp: only needed behind a reverse proxy
dmPickDeviceHelp: Logged in. Which JDownloader of the account should this entry ask?
dmPickHelp: Which program should the adapter ask? Every program can be added as often as you like.
help_maxDownloads: 0 = all downloads. Above the limit, running and failed downloads keep their channel first, completed and seeding ones give it up first.
help_pollInterval: How often every program is asked. My.JDownloader is asked at most every 30 seconds.
help_treeScope: Which downloads get their own channel. The program keeps all of them, and the totals always count every download.
hint_aria2: aria2 must run with --enable-rpc. The RPC secret is the value of --rpc-secret.
hint_deluge: The Web UI plugin must be running. Deluge asks for the password of its web interface, not for a user.
hint_jdownloader: In JDownloader, switch on “DeprecatedApi” under Advanced Settings. That interface has no password — use it only on the same computer or in the same Docker network.
hint_jdownloaderCloud: Log in with your My.JDownloader account. Next you choose which JDownloader of the account this entry asks. My.JDownloader is asked at most every 30 s.
hint_nzbget: User and password are ControlUsername and ControlPassword under Settings → Security.
hint_pyload: pyLoad-ng 0.5 or later. An API key is the preferred login; user and password work too.
hint_qbittorrent: Switch on the Web UI (Options → Web UI). From qBittorrent 5.2 on, an API key works instead of user and password.
hint_sabnzbd: The API key is under Config → General. SABnzbd refuses unknown host names — enter an IP address or add the name to host_whitelist.
hint_transmission: Transmission answers only addresses on its rpc-whitelist — add the address of the ioBroker server there.
label_maxDownloads: At most this many downloads per program in the object tree
warnManyDownloads_text: Every download creates up to 15 objects in the object tree whose values can change with every poll. With 0 (all) or more than 200 downloads per program this quickly adds up to thousands. That puts a load on the ioBroker database and makes the object tree in the admin slow. 100 or fewer is recommended.
warnManyDownloads_title: Many downloads put a load on ioBroker
